name: Smooth Pork, Shiitake & Miso Tonjiru
desc: A smooth reinterpretation of tonjiru: pork, mushrooms, ginger and miso.
method: Add pork, mushrooms, carrot, onion, garlic, ginger and water.
Run Smooth.
Add miso and soy, then Blend briefly.
Finish with sesame oil and black or white pepper.
science: Protein-rich and deeply savoury without relying on potato for body.
note: Tonjiru-inspired rather than traditional; the smooth texture is deliberate.

name: Tom Kha Gai — Smooth Adaptation
desc: Thai chicken, coconut, lemongrass, ginger and chilli, made smooth and coriander-free.
method: Add 210 g cooked chicken, 1 lemongrass stalk, 12 g ginger, 4 garlic cloves, ½ onion, 1 chicken stock cube and the stated liquid to the jug, keeping below the MAX line.
Run the Smooth programme.
Add 160 ml light coconut milk, 1 tsp lime juice, chilli to medium heat, 1 tsp fish sauce.
Blend briefly until the texture is completely smooth, then taste and adjust the seasoning.
science: Chicken provides protein; the coconut and aromatics are primarily there for flavour and texture.
note: Traditional tom kha uses galangal and often coriander; this room-friendly version uses supermarket ingredients.

name: Avgolemono — Smooth Chicken, Rice & Lemon
desc: Greek chicken-and-lemon soup kept creamy and savoury, with the lemon deliberately restrained.
method: Add 210 g cooked chicken, 45 g cooked microwave rice, ½ onion, 2 garlic cloves, 1 chicken stock cube and the stated liquid to the jug, keeping below the MAX line.
Run the Smooth programme.
Add 1 pasteurised egg yolk, 50 g greek yoghurt, 1–2 tsp lemon juice, black pepper.
Blend briefly until the texture is completely smooth, then taste and adjust the seasoning.
science: Chicken supplies protein while rice gives body; yoghurt is a safer room-friendly route to the characteristic creamy texture.
note: For simplicity, the yoghurt finish is preferable to tempering raw egg in a soup maker.

name: Potage à la Reine — Chicken & Almond
desc: A 17th-century French chicken-and-almond soup resurrected as a smooth velouté.
method: Add 220 g cooked chicken, 35 g ground almonds, ½ onion, 3 garlic cloves, 1 chicken stock cube, 390 ml water and the stated liquid to the jug, keeping below the MAX line.
Run the Smooth programme.
Add 60 ml double cream, white pepper.
Blend briefly until the texture is completely smooth, then taste and adjust the seasoning.
science: Almonds provide body without potato while chicken supplies complete protein.
note: Historical recipes varied greatly; this is a practical modern adaptation.

name: Regency White Soup
desc: A pale, rich chicken-and-almond soup inspired by Georgian and Regency-era white soup.
method: Add 210 g cooked chicken, 35 g ground almonds, ½ onion, 2 garlic cloves, 1 chicken stock cube, 400 ml water and the stated liquid to the jug, keeping below the MAX line.
Run the Smooth programme.
Add 70 ml double cream, 1 cooked egg yolk, white pepper.
Blend briefly until the texture is completely smooth, then taste and adjust the seasoning.
science: The combination of chicken, almond and dairy makes this both protein-rich and naturally creamy.
note: The cooked egg yolk is optional but historically appropriate.

name: Savoury Medieval Blancmange
desc: Before blancmange became pudding: chicken, rice, almond, ginger and warm spice.
method: Add 200 g cooked chicken, 45 g cooked rice, 30 g ground almonds, 10 g ginger, ½ onion, 400 ml water and the stated liquid to the jug, keeping below the MAX line.
Run the Smooth programme.
Add 50 ml whole milk, white pepper, tiny pinch of sugar.
Blend briefly until the texture is completely smooth, then taste and adjust the seasoning.
science: Chicken provides protein; rice and almond create the characteristic historical body.
note: Keep any sweetness barely perceptible: this is a savoury reconstruction.

name: Cullen Skink — Potato-Light Smooth Adaptation
desc: Scottish smoked haddock and leek with just enough starch for tradition, not a potato takeover.
method: Add 220 g cooked smoked haddock, 200 g leek, 80 g potato, ½ onion, 1 fish stock cube and the stated liquid to the jug, keeping below the MAX line.
Run the Smooth programme.
Add 80 ml whole milk, 50 ml double cream, black pepper.
Blend briefly until the texture is completely smooth, then taste and adjust the seasoning.
science: Smoked haddock provides substantial protein; the potato quantity is deliberately reduced.
note: This is the one place potato earns its keep because it is part of the dish's identity.

name: West African Groundnut Chicken Soup
desc: Tomato, peanut, chilli and chicken: thick, savoury and naturally soup-maker-friendly.
method: Add 210 g cooked chicken, 300 g chopped tomatoes, ½ onion, 4 garlic cloves, 10 g ginger, ½ tsp smoked paprika, chilli to taste and the stated liquid to the jug, keeping below the MAX line.
Run the Smooth programme.
Add 40 g smooth peanut butter, black pepper.
Blend briefly until the texture is completely smooth, then taste and adjust the seasoning.
science: Chicken and peanut together make this one of the more energy- and protein-dense soups in the collection.
note: No coriander. Use unsweetened peanut butter.

name: Sopa de Tortilla — Smooth Adaptation
desc: Tomato, chilli and toasted-corn flavour with tortilla used as the thickener.
ing: 35 g mature Cheddar or Monterey Jack-style cheese
method: Add 400 g chopped tomatoes, 120 g roasted red pepper, ½ onion, 4 garlic cloves, 1 tsp smoked paprika, chilli to medium heat, 1 vegetable stock cube, 180 ml water and the stated liquid to the jug, keeping below the MAX line.
Run the Smooth programme.
Add 35 g mature cheddar or monterey jack-style cheese, black pepper.
Blend briefly until the texture is completely smooth, then taste and adjust the seasoning.
science: Tomato and pepper provide carotenoids; tortilla thickens the soup without potato.
note: Choose plain lightly salted tortilla chips, not flavoured ones.

name: Chupe de Camarones — Smooth Prawn Adaptation
desc: Peruvian-inspired prawn, sweetcorn, chilli and dairy, stripped of the usual chunks.
ing: 40 g feta or mild white cheese
method: Add 220 g cooked prawns, 200 g sweetcorn, 150 g chopped tomatoes, ½ onion, 3 garlic cloves, ½ tsp smoked paprika, chilli to taste and the stated liquid to the jug, keeping below the MAX line.
Run the Smooth programme.
Add 60 ml whole milk, 40 g feta or mild white cheese, black pepper.
Blend briefly until the texture is completely smooth, then taste and adjust the seasoning.
science: Prawns supply lean protein while corn and tomato provide carotenoids.
note: This is inspired by chupe rather than a literal traditional recipe.

name: Cazuela de Mariscos — Smooth Coconut Seafood
desc: Colombian-inspired mixed seafood, tomato and coconut transformed into a silky bisque.
method: Add 250 g cooked mixed seafood, 280 g chopped tomatoes, ½ onion, 4 garlic cloves, ½ tsp paprika and the stated liquid to the jug, keeping below the MAX line.
Run the Smooth programme.
Add 150 ml light coconut milk, black pepper, 1 tsp lime juice.
Blend briefly until the texture is completely smooth, then taste and adjust the seasoning.
science: Mixed seafood gives a broad protein and micronutrient profile; coconut provides body.
note: Frozen cooked seafood mix is the sensible supermarket option.

name: Fijian Coconut Fish Soup — Smooth Adaptation
desc: White fish, coconut, ginger, garlic and chilli with background lime.
method: Add 230 g cooked white fish, ½ onion, 4 garlic cloves, 12 g ginger, 1 fish stock cube, 320 ml water and the stated liquid to the jug, keeping below the MAX line.
Run the Smooth programme.
Add 160 ml light coconut milk, 1 tsp lime juice, black pepper.
Blend briefly until the texture is completely smooth, then taste and adjust the seasoning.
science: White fish is lean and protein-rich; coconut adds texture and energy.
note: Keep lime subtle rather than sharp.

name: Chorba Frik — Smooth Lamb & Tomato
desc: North-African lamb, tomato and freekeh-inspired soup without coriander.
method: Add 210 g cooked lamb, 320 g chopped tomatoes, 40 g cooked bulgur or freekeh, ½ onion, 4 garlic cloves, 1 tsp cumin, ½ tsp paprika and the stated liquid to the jug, keeping below the MAX line.
Run the Smooth programme.
Add 60 g greek yoghurt, black pepper.
Blend briefly until the texture is completely smooth, then taste and adjust the seasoning.
science: Lamb provides protein, iron and zinc; the grain gives body and fibre.
note: Freekeh can be hard to find, so cooked bulgur is the supermarket-friendly substitute.

name: Caboches in Potage — Smooth Medieval Cabbage
desc: A medieval cabbage, leek and saffron pottage made completely smooth.
method: Add 280 g savoy cabbage, 180 g leek, ½ onion, 3 garlic cloves, 1 vegetable stock cube, 400 ml water, small pinch saffron and the stated liquid to the jug, keeping below the MAX line.
Run the Smooth programme.
Add 50 ml double cream, black pepper.
Blend briefly until the texture is completely smooth, then taste and adjust the seasoning.
science: Cabbage and leek provide fibre and vitamin C; the spices are historically inspired.
note: Humble ingredients, but the saffron makes it much more interesting.

name: Victorian Spanish Chestnut Soup
desc: Chestnut, cream, mace and cayenne from the Victorian repertoire — naturally suited to a smooth machine.
method: Add 220 g vacuum-packed cooked chestnuts, ½ onion, 2 garlic cloves, 1 vegetable or chicken stock cube, 440 ml water, pinch of mace and the stated liquid to the jug, keeping below the MAX line.
Run the Smooth programme.
Add 80 ml double cream, black pepper.
Blend briefly until the texture is completely smooth, then taste and adjust the seasoning.
science: Chestnuts are starchier and lower-fat than most nuts, creating a naturally creamy texture.
note: Very autumnal; chestnut is the point, so don't bury it under spice.
